metaTitle: Custom 5 XLarge Outdoor Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 5 XLarge outdoor blankets for events and giveaways. Perfect for picnics, camping, and sports. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need extra room for group seating or sprawling out at outdoor events, 5 XLarge outdoor blankets offer the generous coverage standard sizes can't match. At 60" x 72" or larger, these oversized blankets accommodate four to six people comfortably on the grass, sand, or stadium bleachers. Choose from fleece for warmth, picnic blankets with water-resistant backing, or sand-repellent styles for beach days. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a branded experience that stands out at company picnics, team outings, or trade show lounges.
heroAltText: Custom 5 XLarge outdoor picnic blanket with logo embroidery, large enough for group seating at events
